setup_dynamo_cache_limit: setup the torch dynamo cache size limit from the DYNAMO_CACHE_SIZE_LIMIT environment variable
setup_multiprocessing_env: setup multi-processing environment variables including fork start method, opencv threads, OMP and MKL threads
register_mmdet_modules: register all mmdet modules including datasets, engine, evaluation, models, and visualization into registries
configure_omp_threads: configure OMP_NUM_THREADS environment variable to avoid system overload when workers_per_gpu is greater than 1
configure_mkl_threads: configure MKL_NUM_THREADS environment variable to avoid system overload when workers_per_gpu is greater than 1
